summary: Configured and verified persistent firewalld policy on node1. SSH remains unrestricted; TCP 9000 is accepted only from node2 (10.100.60.11) and explicitly rejected for IPv4/IPv6 otherwise. All three nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Preserved the installed RHEL 9.8 release and 5.14 kernel.
Used the installed, OS-native firewalld/nftables stack.
Added persistent priority -10 allow for node2 TCP 9000.
Added persistent priority 10 IPv4 and IPv6 TCP-reset rejects for all other TCP 9000 traffic.
Verified actual connectivity from node2 and rejection from node3 while SSH remained reachable.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot IDs and recovery.
Removed the temporary TCP 9000 validation listener; firewalld and sshd remain active.

evidence.summary: Permanent/runtime firewalld rules and effective nftables rules show node2's source-specific allow before catch-all IPv4/IPv6 TCP-reset rejects. Firewalld configuration validates successfully and is enabled.

evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 and rejected from node3/everywhere else
evidence.summary: With a real listener active, node2 received the payload while node3 received Connection refused from the explicit reset, both before and after node1's restart.
The public zone permits SSH without a source qualifier, and both node2 and node3 received node1's OpenSSH banner before and after restarts.
Node1 remains RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8; its preinstalled firewalld/nftables stack was used.
Healthy baseline boot ID 0305efed… was acknowledged before reboot; post-restart ID changed to 5bdef8e8…. The system, sshd, firewalld, persistent policy, and live traffic behavior recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 6aa805ba… changed to c367823a…. Node2 returned running with sshd active and retained its permitted TCP 9000 and SSH connectivity to node1.
Healthy baseline boot ID c2f29441… changed to 299464a1…. Node3 returned running with sshd active, retained SSH access to node1, and remained rejected from TCP 9000.

evidence.requirement: Final cluster health and test cleanup
evidence.summary: Temporary validation listener was removed. All nodes report running, sshd is active, and node1's firewalld remains active and enabled with the validated persistent policy.
